lc_person: Leonard Ira Sweet, church historian and theologian; author of Black images of America, 1784-1870 (1976) and New life in the Spirit (1982).
item_person: Leonard Sweet, theologian affiliated with George Fox University; the same church historian and author identified by LC.

evidence.says: LC authorizes Sweet, Leonard I., with variant Leonard Ira Sweet. Its sources include Black images of America, 1784-1870 (1976). Publisher information for New life in the Spirit (1982) supplies birth year 1947; the 2003 Jesus drives me crazy! source independently repeats 1947 and identifies Sweet as founder and president of SpiritVenture Ministries.
The item describes Leonard Sweet as a theologian, lists George Fox University as employer, and carries LC n81146536 and VIAF 152227. Its birth year 1961 has zero references.

Southeastern University identifies Leonard Sweet as founder and president of SpiritVenture Ministries, visiting distinguished professor at George Fox University, and former president and professor of church history at United Theological Seminary. It states that he earned his PhD at the University of Rochester. These details bridge the LC source notes and the Wikidata affiliation.

The 2023-24 institutional catalog lists Leonard Sweet as president emeritus and professor emeritus of church history, with a University of Rochester PhD in 1974, matching the institution and year in the supplied AHA dissertation evidence.

notes: The matching historical book subject and Rochester PhD year support the graph-person match. The supplied dissertation title ends in 1920, whereas LC cites the published book ending in 1870. The unsupported Wikidata birth year appears erroneous; LC supports 1947. LC HTML was unavailable, so its official structured authority record was read.
